title: Functionality Guide
text: Point isoreader2 folder discover data files inside . generic ir_find_isofiles() finds supported types, ir_find_continuous_flow(), ir_find_dual_inlet(), ir_find_scans() narrow search specific measurement types. bundled example files available via ir_examples_folder().
code: # path to your data folder (here a local copy of the example files) data_folder <- file.path("tmp_examples")  # find continuous flow files (.dxf/.cf) in the folder file_paths <- data_folder |> ir_find_continuous_flow()  # show what was found file_paths [1] "tmp_examples/continuous_flow_ea_example.dxf" [2] "tmp_examples/continuous_flow_gc_example.cf"

title: Functionality Guide
text: Read discovered files. returns ir_isofiles object - tibble one row per file extracted datasets stored nested columns.

title: isoreader2 0.6.0
text: Initial CRAN release. Reads stable isotope data files many vendor formats: Isodat (.dxf, .cf, ., .caf, .scn), IonOS (.iarc), LyticOS (.larc), Callisto (.bch), Qtegra (.imexp), via external isoextract helper (ir_read_isofiles(), ir_extract_isofiles()). Provides consistent object model (ir_isofiles, ir_aggregated_data) tools aggregate (ir_aggregate_isofiles()), convert signal units (ir_convert_intensity()), calculate ratios (ir_calculate_ratios()), filter extend metadata, access extracted data (ir_get_*()). Visualizes continuous flow, dual inlet, scan data (ir_plot_continuous_flow(), ir_plot_dual_inlet(), ir_plot_scans()), builds underlying plotting tibbles directly (ir_generate_*_tibble()). Saves/loads data exports Excel (ir_save_isofiles(), ir_load_isofiles(), ir_export_to_excel()).
